exposure: Different types of labor activity abnormalities (excessive uterine activity, hypotonic uterine activity)
Duration of ruptured fetal membranes before CS
Protracted active first stage of labor
outcome: Inflammation of the uterus (myometrial inflammation, decidual inflammation)
Infiltration with polymorphonuclear leukocytes (PMNs) and macrophages
cohort: The study included 382 patients with singleton pregnancies at 28-42 weeks' gestation who underwent Caesarean section for abnormal uterine contractions and other complications.
finding: Mild inflammation of the decidual membrane and lower segment myometrium is a common physiological phenomenon at term pregnancy contributing to labor initiation; excessive uterine activity is associated with proinflammatory cytokines produced by inflamed decidual and chorioamniotic membranes, while marked myometrial inflammation in prolonged labor aggravates hypotonic uterine activity.
cross-section timing: At the time of Caesarean section, examining tissue samples.
